answer: A spot-audit lottery deters sybil farms by giving each fake identity a chance of review. Each identity puts one marble in an urn each epoch, and a draw picks a sample for work and funding. A drawn reward stays locked in a vault; proven copied work burns 40 credits from the vault and freezes the identity one epoch. The record sits on a public ledge, and the k-th fake needs its own 40-credit deposit, so 1,000 fakes risk 40,000 credits while an honest agent stakes 40 once; the named failure mode, rotation to evade audit, fails because the ledge keeps the source visible.
